messages.author: 9db4061bc19b5b09
messages.subject: rhuz error inside map function
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to deserialized data inside the map function using rhuz. It is throwing an error.


Error in .Call("unserializeUsingPB", r, PACKAGE = "Rhipe") :
  C symbol name "unserializeUsingPB" not in DLL for package "Rhipe"

But, if I try to use this function outside map function, on the output of the unserialized data, It is working fine.
Can anyone help me with this issue. I don't know why I am getting this error.

Thanks
Bikash

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhuz error inside map function
parts:
Yes, this is a bit ugly. Haven't really tackled it.
You can do this

.Call("rh_uz", object.to.be.unserialized)

.Call("rh_sz", object.to.be.serialized)

Tell me if it works.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhuz error inside map function
parts:
First do this *using 0.73.1)

 rhwatch(map=function(a,b) rhcollect(.Call("rh_sz",a),1),inpu=c(10,1), reduce=0)

Your job should succeed.

If so, then rh_sz is present. If rh_uz fails , then your most likely do not have RHIPE serialized data.
